crossoversAudited.observedImpact: Severe degradation of tabular density: heavy 16px blurs, low-contrast text on gradients, and puffy rounded cards reduced visible rows by 50% and increased GPU rendering cost.

auditConclusion: Crossover penalties empirically demonstrate that design profiles cannot be applied indiscriminately across unaligned domains.
